# Engine core: a change to any of these needs a second-family review record (see docs/engine-invariants.md). The glue workspace's js/mozjs-sys/src/engine/** is core too but is a separate workspace.
# One glob per line, relative to the repository root. Lines starting with # are comments.
#
# Generator and VM. This includes bytecode/fncache/**, the function cache that stores bytecode.
src/js/runtime/bytecode/**
# The collector, handles and the heap verifier.
src/js/runtime/gc/**
# The embedding API, host space, jobs, modules and engine cells.
src/js/runtime/embed/**
# Scope analysis and re-parse of lazy functions (the parser's scope code).
src/js/parser/analyze.rs
src/js/parser/scope_tree.rs
src/js/parser/reparse.rs
src/js/parser/reparse_rules.rs
# Keeps the scope tree alive and hands out references into it (parsed_program.rs, a transmute).
src/js/parser/parsed_program.rs
# Runtime scopes and the heap item that carries a scope's names.
src/js/runtime/scope.rs
src/js/runtime/scope_names.rs
